scenes.label: The same picture
scenes.vo: Every civic tech project draws the same map. Red dots, where the complaints came from. But a map of complaints is a map of who owns a phone. It is not a map of need.

scenes.label: What that costs
scenes.vo: Fund the reddest dots, and you fund the districts that shout loudest. The quiet ones stay invisible. And stay unfunded.

scenes.label: Title
scenes.vo: This is CIVOS. A civic operating system, built on one idea. Silence is the signal.

scenes.label: Two doors — LISTEN
scenes.vo: CIVOS has two doors. Citizens come in through this one, reporting what their area needs by speaking, typing, or photographing it. Any language, on the web or over Telegram. Voice buys reach: no reading, no writing, no form to fill. Text buys scale, and absorbs the complaints already sitting in old government systems. A photograph buys proof, and needs no language at all.

scenes.label: Officials — DECIDE
scenes.vo: Officials come in through the other door. Every report lands in BigQuery. Duplicates collapse, so eight hundred reports about one dry borewell become one need, not eight hundred. Real government deprivation data joins in. Then every district and sector falls into one of four boxes.

scenes.label: Silent Need
scenes.vo: The bottom right box is the whole product. Conditions severe, and almost nobody speaking. Silent Need. A hundred and fifty-four of them on this view, districts a complaint map would have called fine.

scenes.label: The honest part
scenes.vo: CIVOS does not send money there. That would replace one guess with another. It tells an officer to go and listen.

scenes.label: The dossier
scenes.vo: And the output is not a dashboard, because nobody can attach a heatmap to a funding request. CIVOS writes a dossier. Karimganj, Assam. Fifty-nine signals, seventeen distinct needs, six languages. Citizens' own words, translated but not tidied. The government's own statistic confirming it: thirty-eight percent of households with no improved water source, measured by the National Family Health Survey. And the national scheme it can be funded under, with a cost. Every claim resolves to a source. Nothing is invented.

scenes.label: Verify and port
scenes.vo: Six months after the money is spent, do the complaints stop? CIVOS measures that too. And the country here is a folder, not code. Drop in South Africa's districts, languages and schemes, and the same engine runs in Zulu.

scenes.label: Close
scenes.vo: CIVOS. Go and ask the districts that never answered.
